_meta.conventions: Targets contract 0.1.0 (bootstrap/analysis/product-sprint/platform-contract): only three structured model outputs exist - IntentResult, PlanProposal, AssessmentResult. Research queries come from WorkflowDefinition.research.queries templates (NOT from the model); policy, approval, action, audit are deterministic non-model stages. CITATION CONVENTION (PROPOSED, contract has no citation field - see README Q-C1): a claim in PlanStepProposal.rationale / PlanProposal.summary cites evidence by suffix markers '[ev:<Evidence.key>]', where key is an EvidenceRequirement.key (e.g. 'description', 'suspicious_content') or 'research:<n>' (n = 1-based index of the research query template, one Evidence per query). SCAM VERDICT (PROPOSED, contract has no verdict schema - README Q-C2): carried in IntentResult.entities {verdict, risk_band, signals[]}; workflow should define intent.entities_schema. Tool names follow the contract fixture (web_search read; dispatch_tow, send_message mock_write) for vehicle_breakdown and LR 04 WIP registries for the other two (report_scam; send_email, create_calendar_event) - those two definitions are not in the contract yet. action_type values for scam/life_admin are ASSUMED ('report', 'schedule') because no definition exists.
